# Quick-filter Escape clears inherited text before pinned state and hides only when no state changes

A copied QuickFilterState resets its last-filter marker. Escape first tries that marker, then clears nonempty text, then clears all remaining filters. The visible-bar controller updates search/widgets for a true relaxation result and hides only for false. The new folder-switch test checks empty text while sticky remains, then cleared sticky, then a hidden bar. Its shared control-state helper explicitly does not prove effective search constraints. Existing two-stage/no-last-filter comments omit this added text stage and should be read against the actual branch; no general three-press or runtime result is claimed.

Scope: Quick-filter inherited state and Escape controller.
